install.packages(c("ncdf4", "dplyr"))
library(ncdf4)
library(dplyr)

nc <- nc_open("~/Downloads/sst.day.mean.2018.nc")
print(nc)  # shows all variables, dimensions, and metadata


extract_sst <- function(nc_file, bird_lat, bird_lon, bird_date) {
  nc <- nc_open(nc_file)
  
  lats <- ncvar_get(nc, "lat")
  lons <- ncvar_get(nc, "lon")
  time_raw <- ncvar_get(nc, "time")
  
  # Origin is 1800-01-01 per your output
  times <- as.Date(time_raw, origin = "1800-01-01")
  
  # Convert negative longitudes to 0-360
  bird_lon_360 <- bird_lon %% 360
  
  lat_idx  <- which.min(abs(lats - bird_lat))
  lon_idx  <- which.min(abs(lons - bird_lon_360))
  time_idx <- which.min(abs(times - as.Date(bird_date)))
  
  sst_val <- ncvar_get(nc, "sst",
    start = c(lon_idx, lat_idx, time_idx),
    count = c(1, 1, 1)
  )
  
  nc_close(nc)
  return(sst_val)
}

bird_df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/FINAL Filtered Chick Data.csv")

bird_df <- bird_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    nc_file = paste0("~/Downloads/sst.day.mean.", Year, ".nc"),
    sst = extract_sst(nc_file, compensatedlat, long, date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
  
  
head(bird_df$sst)

bird_df$nc_file <- NULL
write.csv(bird_df, "~/Downloads/SST updated chick data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
